name: 阿里阿德涅

governance.execution_rule: Use existing host-registered Zeus-governed agents with valid task mandates; this module neither creates agents nor grants authority
governance.delegation_rule: Any later delegation or agent creation follows the shared organization and admission rules
governance.revocation: Host revokes affected mandates and disables module invocation; preserve source records and label history

inputs.command_preparation: source alias, supported source operation and argument array
inputs.authority: actual host mandate and filesystem permissions

outputs.board: items, sourceSnapshots, diagnostics and ready keys
outputs.labels: audited local coordination updates; no source status mutation
outputs.handoff: executable and argv with fresh-check requirements; execution=not_executed

dependencies.external_replacement: Adapters must preserve source identity, evidence, authority and dependency semantics; direct external connectors are not implemented

write: coordination labels and label_history in the designated registry
access.budget: Bound by current host mandate; no standing spend or execution budget

runtime.environment: Node.js with local filesystem; verified on Node 24 Windows
runtime.current_adapter: existing local Zeus ledger and CLI
runtime.compatibility: Existing IDs, source states and ariadne entry remain valid; task types extensible; Feature references optional

cancel_and_resume.reads: Stop and regenerate from fresh source snapshots
cancel_and_resume.labels: Use the shared registry lock and atomic replace; restore classification through audited label changes; after interruption verify no live writer before recovering a stale lock
cancel_and_resume.source_work: Cancellation and recovery are delegated to source-supported operations and host mandates; unsupported transitions are not simulated

acceptance: resolve registered entry and runtime bindings
differentiate definition admission from production deployment
